chapter.verse: Tu-in i gennop thu ahihleh hih bang siampi lianpenpa khat a nei i hihna thu ahi hi. Amah pen vantunga Vanglianpi' kumpi-tokhom ah tu hi.
Mite' bawl ahilo, Topa' phuh biakbuk taktak sunga siangtho munte ah biakpiak nasep a sem ahi hi.
Siampi lianpen cihte pen biakpiak vante leh biakpiaknate a luui dinga kiseh hi a, hih siampi lianpenpa in zong luui ding khatpeuh a neih ding kisam hi.
Tu-in amah leitung ah om himah taleh zong thukhun dung zui-in biakpiak van a luui siampite om ahih manin amah siampi hi tuanlo ding hi.

Biakbuk lam dingin Moses a kithawi laitak Pasian in hilhphawnna pia a,“Na khempeuh mualtunga nang' kianga hong kilak etteh lim zui-in na bawl ding phawk in,” ci hi. Tua hi a, siampite' sep pen vantung thute etsakna lim leh muhtheih liim ciang bek ahi hi.

Ahih hangin kamkhapna palai ahi Khris' hong vaihawm thuciamna ahihleh kamciam a hoihzawte tawh a kiphuangkhia hi a, hoihzaw ahih zah khatin Khris in siampi nasep a dang, a hoihzaw tham, khat a ngah ahi hi.
A hang pen tua thuciam a khatna paubaanglo hileh a nihna, a dang khat, zonbeh kul nawn lo ding hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in tua mite hih bangin mawhsak hi: “En un, Israel innkuan tawh ahi-a Judah innkuan tawh ahi zongin thuciamna a thak khat ka bawl ding hunlenite hong tung ta ding hi, Topa in ci hi.

Tua pen Egypt gam pan amaute a paikhiatpih dingin ka khut tawh ka let ni-a a pupite uh tawh ka bawl thuciamna bang hilo ding hi. A hang pen ka thuciamna zuisuak lo uh ahih manin amaute ka koihdak hi, Topa in ci hi.

A hang pen tua nite khit Israel innkuan tawh ka bawl ding thuciamna hih bang ahi hi, Topa in ci hi: Keima' thukhunte a lungsim sung uhah guangin a lungtang sung uhah ka gelh ding a, tua ciangin kei pen amaute' Pasian hi-in amau pen keima' mite hiding uh hi.

Amaute khatlekhat, khat in a vengpa' kiangah, khat in a sanggampa' kiangah, ‘Topa thei in,’ ci-in kihilh lo ding uh hi. A hang pen amaute a neupen pan a golpen dongin a vekun kei hong thei ding uh hi.
A hang pen amaute' diklohnate ah ka thukhual ding a, a mawhnate uh ka lungsim ah ka koih nawnkei ding hi.”
Pasian in thuciamna a thak khat a pulak ciangin a masazaw pen a lui a suaksak ahi hi. A lui ta, kizattheih hun a bei ta khat pen a maimang ding ahi hi.
